sd_library.name: KONTAKTS SD Application Library
sd_library.description: Current widgets, Platform 0.3.9 system Help and offline UPDATE content. Download the complete ZIP and extract it into the root of the FAT32 SD card; do not flash it to ESP32. Help now covers user, application programmer, system programmer and hardware roles, including BLE/Web/UART transports and the current Sample A connector evidence.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform / BLE + Web + MA01
firmwares.description: Current physically accepted KONTAKTS Platform for ESP32-8048S043. Adds BLE device KONTAKTS-8048 (FFF0 / FFF1 WRITE / FFF2 READ), keeps HMI, Web and technological UART0/P1 on the same command/service layer, and includes the memory hardening required for simultaneous display, SD, Wi-Fi/HTTP, BLE, OTA and MA01 UART1/RS485 operation.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform / Advanced Serial Terminal
firmwares.description: Current KONTAKTS Platform for ESP32-8048S043 with SYS | SD | WIDGET, GitHub OTA, SD application launcher, Widget Runtime, USB Serial Monitor and Advanced Serial Terminal support. Fullscreen keyboard overlay based on LVGL buttonmatrix was physically validated on hardware.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform Stable
firmwares.status: PHYSICAL PASS / RECOVERY BASELINE / WEB FLASHER CANDIDATE
firmwares.description: Known-good KONTAKTS platform baseline with firmware-resident STATUS and OTA, persistent filesystem Widget Runtime, NTP clock support, Storage Manager and physically verified live OTA percentage/progress bar. Use this to restore the platform after experimental builds.

sd_applications.name: Modbus Controller / MA01 Control Center
sd_applications.description: SD package with Modbus T/RH monitor and MA01 Control Center. Uses the platform modbus provider; MA01 field traffic is UART1 GPIO17/18 through an external automatic-direction RS485 transceiver.

sd_applications.name: USB Serial Terminal
sd_applications.description: One SD package with two entrypoints: USB Serial Monitor and Advanced Serial Terminal. Advanced mode supports ASCII/HEX, NONE/LF/CR/CRLF endings, PREV/NEXT history, repeat-last and a fullscreen modal keyboard overlay with CANCEL / OK / SEND.

laboratory_firmwares.description: Six touch cards with HOME, MEDIA and SYSTEM profiles plus Serial commands.

laboratory_firmwares.status: PHYSICAL PASS / WEB FLASHER PHYSICAL PASS / CLOSED
laboratory_firmwares.description: LVGL button, switch, slider, arc, progress indicator and multi-screen navigation.

laboratory_firmwares.name: Live System Dashboard
laboratory_firmwares.status: PHYSICAL PASS / WEB FLASHER PHYSICAL PASS / CLOSED
laboratory_firmwares.description: Real ESP32-S3 temperature, heap, PSRAM and uptime telemetry with a live chart and touch navigation.

laboratory_firmwares.name: Network Provisioning (legacy test)
laboratory_firmwares.description: Earlier standalone Wi-Fi provisioning test. It is not the current KONTAKTS platform and is kept only as historical/diagnostic firmware.

arduino_ide.name: Arduino IDE / ESP32_8048S043 BSP
arduino_ide.status: SEPARATE ARDUINO LINE / SAMPLE A VALIDATION
arduino_ide.description: Separate Arduino IDE development line for ESP32-8048S043. It uses the local N16R8 board profile and the ESP32_8048S043 Arduino library; it is not the KONTAKTS Platform and is not part of the ESP-IDF laboratory firmware branch.
arduino_ide.notes: Arduino CI uses Arduino CLI with esp32 core 3.3.8. Examples 01-05 are compiled in CI; multiple examples 01-14 have Sample A physical validation records, while later LVGL examples include explicit diagnostic/open boundaries.
